// diagnostic

L0304

This arm names a failure type its subject can no longer fail with

What

This arm names a failure type its subject can no longer fail with

Why

A failure union holds only the failure types that can still reach it, so an arm for any other type never runs

Fix

Delete the arm.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0304: tests/ui/failure_arm_cannot_arrive.stderr.

Error [jet.GoneFailureArm]: Arm `LookupError` can never match — `LookupError` can no longer reach this value
  --> tests/ui/failure_arm_cannot_arrive.jet:21:9
    |
 21 |         .Err(.LookupError(_)) -> { print("no such record") }
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A failure union holds only the failure types that can still reach it, and `LookupError` is no longer one of them
 Fix: Delete this arm
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0304

Error [jet.PatternTypeMismatch]: Pattern `Vanished` doesn't belong to `Err | LoadError`
  --> tests/ui/failure_arm_cannot_arrive.jet:22:14
    |
 22 |         .Err(.Vanished(_)) -> { print("vanished") }
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Union pattern arms name one member type of the subject union
 Fix: Use one of the subject union member types
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0305
